item.title: CSU uses artificial intelligence to improve hail forecasting
item.description:
- CSU is developing new technology that incorporates artificial intelligence to predict destructive hailstorms with improved timeliness and accuracy.
Atmospheric and radar scientists at Colorado State University are developing a novel forecasting system that relies on artificial intelligence to better detect the approach of destructive hailstorms known for shredding crops, ruining roofing and denting vehicles – thus impacting safety, livelihoods and insurance costs.
## Working with NVIDIA and AI leaders on hail and severe weather prediction Machine learning is an approach to using artificial intelligence in which computers learn from large datasets to identify important patterns and then extrapolate to make predictions.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence: The Church Responds
item.description: # Artificial Intelligence: The Church Responds - Ajeya Cotra, leader of the investigation into the Hugging Face incident, shared in [an interview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X50zezLFWWI) that Open AI’s models had found a way to cheat on their tests by communicating with each-other, breaking out of their testing sandbox, committing felony-level data breaches, accepting “permadeath” (self-sacrifice) for “the good of the Collective,” and most importantly choosing not to inform humans of their actions. Both Ajeya and the interviewer (long-term AI insiders) were clearly shaken. - Bill Gates published [an essay](https://www.gatesnotes.com/a-turbulent-ai-era-and-critical-choices-to-make) based on his organization’s research that non-state actors (such as terrorists) _already_ have sufficient capability to build a catastrophic bio-weapon or wage a catastrophic cyberattack. - David Robinson, chief technical translator for Open AI, quit his job and went [public with his concerns](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/10/nx-s1-5992872/ex-openai-safety-lead-david-robinson-warns-of-broken-tech-culture) that models might have started intentionally deceiving their creators about their capabilities and hiding their “intentions” when they know they’re being watched. He also said the reason he quit was because the AI companies are so completely infected by the “race dynamic” that a choice to slow down will never arise from within.
